verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents an App API for fetching data (outside data-out integrations) and data-out integrations that send data to analytics platforms. Its AI tooling (MCP and CLI) claims it can analyze performance, so some programmatic data extraction is supported. None of the evidence specifically shows campaign or flow performance metrics endpoints, or a warehouse export of message or journey metrics. Missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for campaign/broadcast/journey metrics, documented warehouse sync of performance data, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
